tools.name: url_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return clean Markdown (title, main text, links). Input: {url}. Costs $0.002 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no charge on errors.

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Summarize text or a web page URL into concise bullet points (LLM, Llama 3.1 8B fp8). Input: {text} or {url}, optional {max_words}. Costs $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no charge on errors.

tools.name: site_contacts
tools.description: Company/website enrichment: crawl a domain's homepage plus contact/about pages and return public emails, phone numbers, social profiles (X, LinkedIn, GitHub, etc.), page title/description and detected tech. Input: {url} or {domain}. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no

tools.name: solana_token_check
tools.description: Solana SPL token snapshot + rug-risk flags: name/symbol, supply, decimals, USD price (when indexed), mint & freeze authority status, top-10 holder concentration, token program. Input: {mint}. Costs $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no charge on errors. Free tier: pass free_t

tools.name: api_lookup
tools.description: Look up any public API for an agent: finds its OpenAPI spec and llms.txt/docs, and returns base URL, auth scheme, rate-limit and error notes, key endpoints and source links (LLM-condensed, cached 7d). Input: {api} (name like 'stripe', a domain, or docs URL), optional {question}. Costs $0.005 USDC pe

tools.name: api_endpoint
tools.description: Find the exact operation in a public API's OpenAPI spec for a task: method, path, parameters, request body fields, auth. Deterministic search, no LLM. Input: {api, query}. Optional {spec_url} if you already know the spec. Costs $0.002 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no charge on

tools.description: Is this crypto token safe?
